items: HDMI extender splitter kit (transmitter + receivers, 1x2 or 1x4)
why: Both ChatGPT answers recommend one boxed product per situation (OREI UHD12-EX115-K for 2 TVs, J-Tech JTECH-14EX60-AE for 4, OREI UHD14-EXB400-K HDBaseT for long runs). None of them names a second item the shopper must add. These transmitter-plus-receiver kits already ship and were carded as single products, so the deciding facts (output count, 4K60 at distance, HDBaseT vs plain Cat6, and splitter vs matrix) belong in a single-product comparison rather than a kit.
